# ataila_customer_entitlements (Data Source)

Every service a customer holds, in any state, with its seat use. Needs a token holding `entitlements-read-global` (or the admin key) and platform release 1.0.392 or later. A tenant-scoped token reads its own customer's only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ataila_customer_entitlements" "example" {
  customer_id = ataila_customer.example.id
}

# Seats left per service.
output "seats_left" {
  value = {
    for e in data.ataila_customer_entitlements.example.entitlements :
    e.service_key => e.seats == null ? null : e.seats - e.seats_used
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `customer_id` (String) Id of the customer.

### Read-Only

- `entitlements` (Attributes List) The customer's entitlements, in the catalogue's display order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entitlements))

<a id="nestedatt--entitlements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entitlements`

Read-Only:

- `approved` (Boolean) An operator approved the entitlement in the portal (needed only for a service that `requires_approval`).
- `approved_at` (String) When it was approved: RFC 3339 in UTC; null when not.
- `dedicated_url` (String) The customer's own instance of a `dedicated` service; null until it exists.
- `notes` (String) Free text.
- `seats` (Number) How many people may hold a grant under it at once; null means no limit.
- `seats_used` (Number) How many people hold an unrevoked grant under it.
- `service_key` (String) The service's key.
- `service_name` (String) The service's display name.
- `state` (String) `enabled` (in force), `pending_approval` (asked for, waiting for an operator's approval in the portal: no grant under it is in force) or `disabled` (withdrawn: no grant under it is in force).
- `url` (String) Where the customer uses the service: `dedicated_url` when set, else the service's own `url`.
